description: Section 2 — Supplier SJ Validation Tool (prevention of under-invoicing), MINUS live email. Build a production-grade cross-check engine that compares the field Surat Jalan tonnage/price (captured in the FEAT-002 weighbridge/reconciliation data) against the supplier's Excel recap, a mismatch flagging/alert UI, and a dummy-data demo scenario with a how-it-works guide. The live email ingestion (handoff item 2.1) is DEFERRED — design email ingestion as a PLUGGABLE interface (an adapter contract the app can call to fetch supplier recaps) but do NOT implement a live mailbox provider. Depends on FEAT-002 (weighbridge/reconciliation data is the field-SJ source of truth).
steps: Create a new classic IIFE module public/classic/core/sj-validation.js (declare no top-level globals; expose exactly one window.* object, e.g. window.SJValidation). Register it in vite.config.js classicAll at the correct position (after sales-purchase-extras.js / erp-view.js it depends on, before rbac.js/lazy-views.js).

CROSS-CHECK ENGINE: implement a pure function that takes (a) field Surat Jalan / weighed records (from FEAT-002: per line net tonnage + unit price, keyed by DO/PO/item) and (b) a parsed supplier recap (rows of item, qty/tonnage, price). Match rows (by DO number / PO number / item + date), compute per-row tonnage variance and price variance, and return a structured result with a mismatch flag when tonnage or price differ beyond a small configurable tolerance. This is the core of preventing under-invoicing.

SUPPLIER RECAP PARSING: reuse the SheetJS reader pattern from public/classic/core/excel-import.js (window.XLSX is available) to parse an uploaded supplier Excel recap into the row shape the engine expects. Use docs/pitch/Contoh_SuratJalan_Excel.xlsx and Template-Import-Nusantara.xlsx (Delivery Orders sheet headers) to inform the expected columns.

PLUGGABLE EMAIL INGESTION INTERFACE: define a small adapter contract, e.g. window.SJValidation.registerRecapSource({ id, label, fetchRecaps() }), and ship a manual 'upload file' source implementing it. Document that a future email-mailbox source implements the same contract. Do NOT wire a real email provider or network mailbox.

MISMATCH ALERT UI: add a 'Validasi SJ Supplier' view that lists reconciliations/receipts, lets the user attach a supplier recap (via the upload source), runs the cross-check, and shows a clear visual flag (color-coded row/badge) on every tonnage or price mismatch BEFORE an invoice is issued. Register the view in nav.js MENU_CONFIG (Purchases group) and menu-router.js ROUTES. Match existing view/table styling.

DEMO READINESS: add a dummy-data demo scenario (a small seed of a field SJ/weighed record plus a matching-and-a-mismatching supplier recap) so the mismatch flagging can be demonstrated, and a short how-it-works guide at docs/SJ_VALIDATION_DEMO.md (Indonesian, matching the docs/pitch tone) describing the workflow and the demo steps. Reference docs/pitch/SKRIP_DEMO.md style. Do NOT add agent self-attribution to the doc.

Add Vitest coverage tests/sj-validation.test.ts importing ../public/classic/core/sj-validation.js: assert the cross-check flags a tonnage mismatch, flags a price mismatch, passes a matching row within tolerance, and handles unmatched rows. The test must fail if the variance/flagging logic were reverted.
acceptance_criteria: A pure cross-check engine compares field Surat Jalan tonnage/price vs a parsed supplier recap and flags tonnage or price mismatches beyond tolerance.
Supplier recap Excel files parse via SheetJS into the engine's expected row shape.
Email ingestion is a documented pluggable adapter contract with a working manual-upload source; NO live mailbox is implemented.
A 'Validasi SJ Supplier' view visually flags mismatches before invoicing, reachable from the Purchases menu.
A dummy-data demo scenario + docs/SJ_VALIDATION_DEMO.md guide exist.
`npm run test:run` passes including sj-validation tests that would fail if the flagging logic were reverted; the new classic file is in vite.config.js classicAll.
findings: Implemented public/classic/core/sj-validation.js (IIFE, single window.SJValidation) + sj-validation.d.ts stub. Registered in vite.config.js classicAll right after pipeline-extras.js and before rbac.js/lazy-views.js. Cross-check engine crossCheck(fieldLines, recapRows, options) is a pure function with configurable tolerance (DEFAULT_TOLERANCE: tonnageAbs 0.05 / tonnagePct 1% / priceAbs Rp1 / pricePct 0.5%; passes within EITHER absolute or percentage band). Matching keys on PO/DO number + item; item NAME is the primary item token (supplier recaps only carry names, not our internal item codes) with code/id as fallback — this was the fix for the demo-seed test that initially mismatched itemId vs itemName. Recap parsing via SheetJS (parseRecapWorkbook / rowsFromAoa) mirrors excel-import.js and accepts both Template-Import-Nusantara.xlsx Delivery Orders headers and Indonesian recap headers. Pluggable source contract: registerRecapSource({id,label,fetchRecaps}) with a shipped 'upload' manual-file source; email/mailbox is documented as a future adapter, NOT wired. View 'Validasi SJ Supplier' injects into host view 'purchase' (same pattern as Rekonsiliasi), added to nav.js purchases group and menu-router.js ROUTES (label -> ['SJValidation','openValidation']); color-coded mismatch badges + a red pre-invoice warning banner + unmatched-recap panel. Demo: seedDemo() seeds reconciled receipt GR-DEMO-SJ (Batu Andesit matching, Pasir Cor overstating tonnage+price) reachable via the 'Muat Contoh Demo' header button; guide at docs/SJ_VALIDATION_DEMO.md (Indonesian). Tests: tests/sj-validation.test.ts (14 tests) assert tonnage-mismatch flag, price-mismatch flag, both, pass-within-tolerance, tiny-variance pass, unmatched recap, unmatched field, custom tolerance, DO-number matching, receipt flattening, demo seed, and the source contract. VERIFICATION: npm run test:run 269 pass (was 255 + 14 new); npm run type-check shows only the 12 pre-existing errors (11 rbac.test.ts + 1 twofa-flow.test.ts), no new ones; npm run lint clean (fixed 2 prettier warnings in the test via eslint --fix); npm run build succeeds (bundle concatenates without redeclaration). Left package-lock.json unstaged — it carried a pre-existing unrelated libc-field diff not produced by this task.
